style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF for packshots and info screens; full-bleed fresh green #91C058 panels for poster and radial-diagram screens; straight-corner photo cards outlined by a thin #91C058 keyline on #FFFFFF

style.lightingSystem: bright fresh studio daylight, soft top-front key with gentle fill, clean soft contact shadows, subtle cool daylight quality around 5500K, no harsh speculars

noDrift: no rounded or thick-stroked photo frames
style.presentationRules: stable product scale and centered placement across the set; the hero product appears as whole fruit while cross-section and peel close-ups are reserved for dedicated macro shots; all frames and cards keep sharp 90-degree corners
